answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the anchor is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra ocean buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each garden has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 17cu7.
